defects: Approach relies on "checks need npm packages" but defines no predicate or behavior when setup command/lockfile is missing. Existing generator only emits build-time install when caller explicitly supplies optional `--setup-command`; thus task with npm-based test and omitted flag still reaches no-network verifier without deps.
Plan runs build and verifier in container but omits required runtime-file inventory and target-environment real-agent control.
